Name: Immersive Spouses for 1.6
Author: SuperMonkey1308
Description:
[size=3]This mod is just a fix for the bus stop bug in Immersive Spouses where spouses would get stuck at the bus stop. I will not be adding any features to the mod, if anyone else wants to and finish the mod, go ahead, I don't care, just the original creator of the mod said that it was okay to post updated versions of the mod.

[/size]Original Mod Page:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5117]Immersive Spouses - Improved Spouse Schedules at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]

Downloads.Description: Fixed a few changes for Abigail and Sam's schedules that I missed.
